_comment: The 35 flat horizon.* functions: hand-written shims in ScriptContext.cpp (kHorizonFuncs) and PyScriptBackend.cpp, NOT registry rows. Signatures are read off luaL_check*/luaL_opt* and PyArg_ParseTuple; [x] = optional. 'twin' = the registry id that does the same job (link target), null when there is none. gen_reference.py fails if this list and kHorizonFuncs disagree.

items.name: log
items.desc: Writes a line to the Console panel and to HorizonEngine.log. The only way to reach the log row from a script: there is no horizon.log.* group.

items.name: getName
items.desc: The entity's name, "" for an invalid id.

items.name: spawn
items.desc: Creates an empty entity named name (default "Entity") under parent and returns its id. parent 0 or invalid = top level. Unlike horizon.entity.spawn, the name is optional here.

items.name: destroy
items.desc: Removes the entity; an invalid id is ignored. Check the id first: in a script 0 is the scene root, not “nothing”.

items.name: getPosition
items.desc: Local position, i.e. relative to the parent. (0, 0, 0) for an invalid id. There is no horizon.transform.* group, so this is the only script route to the row.

items.name: setPosition
items.desc: Sets the local position. On an entity with a rigid body or a character controller this is a teleport, so the physics step does not snap it back.

items.name: getRotation
items.desc: Local Euler rotation in degrees. (0, 0, 0) for an invalid id.

items.name: setRotation
items.desc: Sets the local Euler rotation in degrees; a teleport on physics bodies, like setPosition.

items.name: getScale
items.desc: Local scale. (1, 1, 1) for an invalid id.

items.name: setScale
items.desc: Sets the local scale.

items.name: raycast
items.args: ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz [, maxDist]
items.desc: Casts a ray from the origin along the direction, up to maxDist (default 1000). Returns a flat table (Lua) / dict (Python) with the keys entity, x, y, z (hit point), nx, ny, nz (surface normal) and distance, or nil / None on a miss or without a physics world. horizon.physics.raycast answers the same question as ten return values and also reports the hit layer.

items.name: setVelocity
items.desc: Drives the character controller if the entity has one, its rigid body otherwise. No-op without a physics world.

items.name: isGrounded
items.desc: Whether the entity's character controller stands on ground. false without a physics world or a controller.

items.name: setMaterialParam
items.args: entity, name, x [, y, z, w]
items.desc: Sets the node-graph material parameter name on the entity's material at runtime. One to four numbers, omitted ones are 0, so a scalar parameter takes just x. false when the entity has no material or the parameter does not exist. There is no horizon.material.* group.

items.name: getMaterialParam
items.desc: Reads a material parameter back as four numbers; (0, 0, 0, 0) when it cannot be found.

groups.title: In-game UI elements
groups.note: These act on entities that carry UI components (a UI canvas in the scene). Widgets built in the Widget Designer are a different thing, see the next table.

items.name: setUIText
items.desc: Replaces the text of the entity's UI Text component.

items.name: getUIText
items.desc: The text of the UI Text component, "" without one.

items.name: setUIColor
items.desc: Sets the element's primary colour: image tint, text colour or button normal colour, whichever exists (image first). a defaults to 1.

items.name: getUIColor
items.desc: The primary colour in the same order; (1, 1, 1, 1) when there is none.

items.name: setUIVisible
items.desc: Switches the UI element on or off, together with everything under it.

items.name: isUIVisible
items.desc: Whether the UI element is switched on.

items.name: setUIPosition
items.desc: Moves the element, in canvas units.

items.name: getUIPosition
items.desc: The element's position in canvas units.

items.name: setUISize
items.desc: Resizes the element, in canvas units.

items.name: getUISize
items.desc: The element's size in canvas units.

items.name: setUIMaterialParam
items.args: entity, name, x [, y, z, w]
items.desc: setMaterialParam for the material of the entity's UI Image. false without one or for an unknown parameter.

groups.title: Widgets
groups.note: Widgets are instances of Widget Designer assets. They live outside the entity world and are addressed by the widget id createWidget returns, not by an entity id. The rest of the widget API (lists, animation, popups, children) is horizon.widget.*.

items.name: createWidget
items.desc: Instantiates the widget asset at the content-relative path and returns its id, 0 on failure. HorizonCode does the same with the Create Widget node.

items.name: destroyWidget
items.desc: Removes the widget instance.

items.name: showWidget
items.desc: Shows the widget on screen.

items.name: hideWidget
items.desc: Hides it again; the instance and its state stay.

items.name: setWidgetZOrder
items.desc: Draw order among widgets: higher is on top.

items.name: isWidgetVisible
items.desc: Whether the widget is currently shown.

items.name: callWidgetFunction
items.desc: Calls a public function of the widget's graph by name. false for a private or unknown function.

items.name: showCursor
items.desc: Releases the mouse and shows the pointer, e.g. for a menu. There is no horizon.cursor.* group.

items.name: hideCursor
items.desc: Hides the pointer and grabs the mouse again for camera control.
